claims.text: Alila Ventana Big Sur is a resort on the California coast, overlooking the Pacific Ocean and surrounded by redwood forest.

findings.quote: Alila Ventana Big Sur is a luxury resort on the California coast, overlooking the Pacific Ocean, surrounded by redwood forest, and tailored to adults.
findings.note: Covers the coastal location, the Pacific views and the redwood forest.

claims.text: The resort sits 1,200 feet above the Pacific, among meadows and wooded hillsides.

findings.quote: The newly-updated Ventana is set on 243 acres of meadows and wooded hillsides 1,200 feet above the Pacific, surrounded on all sides by epic nature.
findings.note: Covers the elevation and the meadows and wooded hillsides.

claims.text: The resort is near Pfeiffer Beach, Bixby Bridge and Point Sur Lighthouse.

findings.quote: Located near Pfeiffer Beach, Bixby Bridge and Point Sur Lighthouse, the resort provides access to iconic Big Sur attractions.
findings.note: All three landmarks are named.

claims.text: Most rooms and suites have wood-burning fireplaces, decks with ocean or forest views and private hot tubs.

findings.quote: Most of our 54 rooms and suites feature wood-burning fireplaces, decks with ocean or forest views and private hot tubs.
findings.note: Covers all three features.

claims.text: Guests can stay in a standalone villa or in one of the resort's glamping sites.

findings.quote: Enjoy extra privacy in a standalone villa or relax in nature in one of our glamping sites.
findings.note: Names both the standalone villa and the glamping sites.

claims.text: The two-story Big Sur Villa has ocean and forest views, a private deck and a living area with a fireplace.

findings.quote: Stay in our two-story, 1,000-square-foot Big Sur Villa, featuring ocean and forest views, a private deck and a living area with a fireplace.
findings.note: Covers every listed feature of the villa.

claims.text: Rooms mix mid-century and rustic-chic style, with working fireplaces, stone and wood.

findings.quote: the 59 mid-century-meets-rustic-chic rooms now feature working fireplaces, muted colors, lots of stone and wood
findings.note: Covers the style, the working fireplaces and the stone and wood.

claims.text: Spa Alila combines intuitive traditions from Indonesia with holistic techniques from Europe.

findings.quote: Big Sur provides a setting for natural healing combined with intuitive traditions from Indonesia and holistic techniques from Europe.
findings.note: Covers both the Indonesian and the European elements.

claims.text: Complimentary seasonal programming includes guided hikes, forest bathing, meditation, wellness classes and nature experiences.

findings.quote: Enjoy complimentary seasonal programming inspired by Big Sur, including guided hikes, forest bathing, meditation, wellness classes and nature experiences.
findings.note: Every listed activity is named.

claims.text: Guests can join a group class at the Ventana beehives.

findings.quote: Learn about these impressive beehives with a group class at Alila Ventana
findings.note: Confirms a group class at the beehives.

claims.text: The Sur House uses fresh ingredients from the resort's organic garden, and its terrace has ocean views.

findings.quote: Ocean views from the terrace area are as breathtaking as our Big Sur-inspired cuisine, which features fresh ingredients from our expansive organic garden.
findings.note: Covers both the terrace ocean views and the organic garden ingredients.

claims.text: The Glass House offers private dining with ocean views and a prix fixe menu.

findings.quote: Our exquisite Glass House and its breathtaking ocean views create a private dining experience like no other. Perched on the edge of the continent, your party will enjoy a prix fixe menu
findings.note: Covers private dining, ocean views and the prix fixe menu.

claims.text: The secluded Mountain Pool sits high atop the resort among towering redwoods, next to Japanese hot baths for communal bathing.

findings.quote: Meanwhile, our secluded Mountain Pool is perched high atop the resort, surrounded by towering redwoods, with adjacent Japanese hot baths offering a serene communal bath experience.
findings.note: Covers every element of the claim.

claims.text: Meadow Pool has views of the ocean and redwood forest, private cabanas and an infinity-edge hot tub.

findings.quote: Meadow Pool delivers expansive views of the ocean and redwood forest, as well as private cabanas and an infinity-edge hot tub.
findings.note: Covers every element of the claim.

claims.text: Breakfast, lunch and dinner are included throughout the stay, from dinner on arrival day to breakfast on departure day.

findings.quote: Dinner on your arrival day
findings.note: Covers dinner on arrival day.

findings.quote: Breakfast on your departure day
findings.note: Covers breakfast on departure day.

findings.quote: Breakfast, lunch and dinner throughout your stay
findings.note: Covers all meals throughout the stay.

claims.text: The Cottage is a standalone villa with a private deck with a hammock, forest canyon views and an outdoor hot tub.

findings.quote: choose this 725-square-foot standalone villa, featuring one king bed and a private deck with a hammock, forest canyon views and an outdoor hot tub.
findings.note: Covers every element of the Cottage description.

claims.text: Guests can join a master falconer for an introduction to hawks, falcons and owls.

findings.quote: join a master falconer for an unforgettable introduction to hawks, falcons and owls
findings.note: Matches the claim.

claims.text: The resort does not offer amenities, programming or an environment typically suited to guests traveling with children.

findings.quote: does not offer amenities, programming, or an environment typically suited to guests traveling with children.
findings.note: Matches the claim.

claims.text: Accommodations are limited to a maximum of two guests per room.

findings.quote: our accommodations are limited to a maximum of two guests per room.
findings.note: Matches the claim.

claims.text: Cell reception at the resort is very limited.

findings.quote: The Wi-Fi is free, but the cell reception is pretty much nonexistent.
findings.note: Reviewer reports near-nonexistent cell reception.
